items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Met some interesting people. A guy named Ernest Borneman.

ctx.x: Was that the first time you’d been to Europe.

No. I went to England when it was time to edit The Trouble With Cinderella. I decided I might as well edit it. It’s a mechanical job, and the book was more or less finished. There were some inserts and excerpts to make, and so on. So I stayed at the Savoy Hotel and wandered around London when I wasn’t working. Met some interesting people. A guy named Ernest Borneman. Did you ever hear of Ernest?
